description: Source code for the ImageImporterPng class, which handles importing PNG images within the PdfSharp library's internal drawing mechanisms. It includes methods for testing PNG headers, reading image information, and converting PNG data into a format suitable for PDF generation.

classes.name: ImageImporterPng
classes.description: Handles importing PNG images, verifying headers, reading pixel data, and converting PNG to internal PDF image data structures.

classes.name: ImportedImagePng
classes.description: Represents a PNG image imported into the PDF, capable of preparing image data for rendering.

classes.name: ImagePrivateDataPng
classes.description: Holds the raw bitmap, alpha mask, and palette data for PNG images used in PDF creation.

methods.name: ImportImage
methods.description: Main method to import a PNG image from a stream, returning an ImportedImage if successful.

methods.name: TestPngFileHeader
methods.description: Checks if the current stream contains a PNG file by verifying header bytes.

methods.name: TestPngInfoHeader
methods.description: Reads PNG image headers to extract width, height, color type, and bit depth, and sets up image format accordingly.

methods.name: PrepareImageData
methods.description: Converts internal PNG data into a format suitable for PDF image embedding (not implemented here).
